evidence.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; save me by Your righteousness.
Into Your hands I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O LORD, God of truth.
I hate those who cling to worthless idols, but in the LORD I trust.
Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes fail from sorrow, my soul and body as well.
But I trust in You, O LORD; I say, “You are my God.”
O LORD, let me not be ashamed, for I have called on You. Let the wicked be put to shame; let them lie silent in Sheol.
Blessed be the LORD, for He has shown me His loving devotion in a city under siege.
Love the LORD, all His saints. The LORD preserves the faithful, but fully repays the arrogant.
Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the LORD.

matchReviews.senseReview: Only literal uppercase LORD is admitted globally. Source Lord article explicitly covers God as Lord; lowercase human lord and sentence-title Lord are not inferred from this rule.

c: The psalmist encourages the godly to find refuge in the Lord and wait for his salvation. Despite having had a death-like experience, he testifies to the Lord’s faithfulness. This psalm foreshadows the suffering of Jesus (
The Lord offers refuge to anyone who comes to him for protection. The psalmist trusts in and submits to the Lord. See also
The psalmist issues an urgent call for the Lord to pay attention to his desperate situation (

Trust in the Lord requires confidence that he has our best interests at heart.

This is a powerful description of how despair takes a toll on our physical well-being.
Hope does not confide in frail and changeable human beings but only in the Lord. The sufferer entrusts himself to God while waiting for the Lord’s justice.

The psalmist expresses his joy at the experience of God’s goodness and love. Throughout his ordeal, the Lord has cared for him.

Out of his own pain and renewed awareness of the Lord’s goodness, the psalmist turns to others who suffer. He holds out the promise of God’s loving care for those who persevere in hoping for the Lord.
